align_bpe_to_words: align GPT-2 BPE tokens to spaCy word tokens using a RoBERTa model instance
align_features_to_words: align RoBERTa BPE-level features to word-level features using a BPE-to-word alignment map
spacy_nlp: get a singleton spaCy English NLP pipeline instance for tokenization and parsing
spacy_tokenizer: get a singleton spaCy tokenizer created from the default English NLP pipeline
review_alignment_utils: review the RoBERTa alignment utilities module for BPE-to-word token alignment and feature aggregation
